fields.expected:
Two things I built are probably the most useful signal of how I think. The first is a Playwright job-application agent in TypeScript that I designed to be deterministic and operator-controlled rather than autonomous, because one wrong action can submit a real application or fabricate an answer. Every application moves through an explicit state machine, SQLite is the single source of truth so state cannot diverge across processes, and mutating capabilities sit behind fail-closed flags that never default on. Free-text essays and demographic fields are architecturally prevented from being auto-filled and always generate a human-review item. I am filling this box out by hand for that reason.

The second is ClarityAtlas, an iOS health app I built end to end in Swift and SwiftUI with Supabase, including a passive sleep-estimation system using HealthKit and Core Motion signals so users would not need a wearable. We shipped it into a live Hopkins pilot with 30+ users.

I want to work somewhere I own substantial pieces of a system rather than isolated tickets, and where taste about what a system should not do counts as much as what it can.
